This exception is thrown immediately upon detecting an invalid state (negative height), with no recovery attempt within the method. The condition is a guard against an invariant violation. The programmer likely intended this exception to indicate a programming error (e.g., a stack underflow) that should not occur under correct usage. The exception is thrown to halt further processing and highlight the bug, rather than to be caught and handled externally.
